lexical-quality: synonyms and spell correction (PLAN J13; 5.5, 5.6).

An agent searches with a word the notes never use, rewords it, and finds the note. kb synonyms
suggest turns that reword into a synonyms.txt line; once pasted, the first word finds the note
too. A typo that finds nothing is searched again as its correction, and kb says so on stderr.

  $ kb init --model fake:8
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/session.md
  added data/session.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/cluster.md
  added data/cluster.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/deploy.md
  added data/deploy.md (2 chunks)

The first word finds nothing; the reworded query finds the note, and the agent marks it useful.

  $ kb search signout --mode fts --caller agent
  search 1 · 0 hits
  no results
  search_id=1

  $ kb search logout --mode fts --caller agent
  search 2 · 2 hits
  [1] data/session.md · updated 2026-09-01
  Ending a session: How to logout of the dashboard.

  [2] data/session.md › (intro) · updated 2026-09-01
  Ending a session › (intro)
  # Ending a session

  Click your avatar, then logout. The session cookie is cleared.
  search_id=2

  $ kb feedback --last 1 --useful --caller agent
  recorded: search 2 rank 1 useful=1 (newest search for agent, (time): "logout")

kb synonyms suggest mines the log for that reword. Its output pastes as synonyms.txt.

  $ kb synonyms suggest
  # kb synonyms suggest · 2 searches · 1 reworded pair (window 5m0s)
  # paste the groups you approve into $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/synonyms.txt (kb never writes it)

  # 1 pair, 1 caller (signout -> logout 1); chunks: logout 2, signout 0
  logout, signout

  # gaps: words of searches without a useful hit or open that no chunk holds
  #   signout (1 search)

  $ write .kb/stores/default/synonyms.txt @synonyms

  $ kb search signout --mode fts
  search 3 · 2 hits
  [1] data/session.md · updated 2026-09-01
  Ending a session: How to logout of the dashboard.

  [2] data/session.md › (intro) · updated 2026-09-01
  Ending a session › (intro)
  # Ending a session

  Click your avatar, then logout. The session cookie is cleared.
  search_id=3

A typo of a word two notes hold (a transposition, which stemming does not fold) is also searched
as its correction, and a note on stderr says so.

  $ kb search kuberntes --mode fts
  search 4 · 4 hits
  [1] data/deploy.md · updated 2026-09-01
  Deploying: Ship a release to kubernetes.

  [2] data/cluster.md · updated 2026-09-01
  Cluster basics: Our kubernetes cluster layout.

  [3] data/deploy.md › (intro) · updated 2026-09-01
  Deploying › (intro)
  # Deploying

  Push the image, then roll the kubernetes deployment.

  [4] data/cluster.md › (intro) · updated 2026-09-01
  Cluster basics › (intro)
  # Cluster basics

  The kubernetes control plane runs three nodes.
  search_id=4
  [stderr] note: also searched "kubernetes" for "kuberntes"
